title: Fortune Brands Innovations (FBIN) CEO Jesse Singh outlines business strategy and market leadership
digest:
Jesse Singh, newly appointed CEO of Fortune Brands Innovations (FBIN), stated on November 11, 2026, that the company will focus on leveraging its Moen, Therma-Tru, and Master Lock brands to strengthen its dominance in the water infrastructure, outdoor living, and security hardware markets【新】.

FBIN operates in three core segments: water products (Moen), entry door solutions (Therma-Tru), and security hardware (Master Lock). Singh emphasized that the company's existing market positions provide a foundation for innovation and expansion, particularly in smart home integration and sustainable materials【新】.
